Protests in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir draw international attention

Protests have erupted in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir (PoJK) following a crackdown, with demonstrators highlighting a food crisis and calling for reunification with India. Overseas Kashmiris in London held a gathering, and activists have called for global protests. Some protesters are seeking India's assistance.
